label: SamCart
description: Manage orders, customers, products, charges, refunds and subscriptions

operations.name: list_refunds
operations.description: Get a paginated list of refunds for the marketplace. Custom sorting is not allowed, and results are sorted by Refund ID.

operations.name: list_charge_refunds
operations.description: Retrieve all refunds on a charge

operations.name: list_customer_orders
operations.description: Retrieve all orders for a customer

operations.name: list_customer_subscriptions
operations.description: Retrieve all subscriptions for a customer

operations.name: list_customer_charges
operations.description: Retrieve all charges for a customer

operations.name: list_order_charges
operations.description: Retrieve all charges on an order

operations.name: list_order_subscriptions
operations.description: Retrieve all subscriptions on an order

operations.name: refund_charge
operations.description: Refund an individual charge. Omit amount for full refund, or specify amount in cents for partial refund.

operations.name: cancel_subscription
operations.description: Cancel an individual subscription. Only subscriptions with an active, delinquent, or paused status may be canceled.

operations.name: schedule_cancel_subscription
operations.description: Schedule an individual subscription to be canceled. Only subscriptions with an active status may be scheduled.

operations.name: update_subscription
operations.description: Update a subscription. Currently supports updating the next rebilling date. Only subscriptions with an active or delinquent status may be updated.
